description: AI-native BuildOS for Codex, Claude Code and Doubao: product discovery, UI/UX design, software engineering, context-aware workflows, testing, Git and verifiable releases.

summary.zh: 把跨会话注意力衰减转成项目自有的事实、决定、任务和证据路线，并以宜疏不宜堵治理缺陷生产源。
summary.en: Turn cross-session attention loss into project-owned facts, decisions, task state, and evidence while fixing defect sources before adding gates.
summary.ja: 会話をまたぐ注意の減衰を、プロジェクト所有の事実・判断・タスク・証拠経路へ変え、gate より先に欠陥の発生源を正します。
